hero.title: Why Choose Five Investment Limited
hero.subtitle: Your trusted partner for construction, procurement, agriculture, and sustainable development in South Sudan.

intro.title: Building Trust Through Excellence
intro.text: Since our establishment in 2013, Five Investment Limited has been committed to delivering reliable, high-quality services with honesty, professionalism, and a client-first approach. Our reputation is built on integrity, timely delivery, and lasting partnerships.

whyClients.title: Why Clients Choose Us
whyClients.description: We bring more to the table than just services – we bring commitment.

cards.title: Proven Experience
cards.text: More than a decade of experience serving government institutions, NGOs, private companies, and communities across South Sudan.

cards.title: Honesty & Integrity
cards.text: We conduct every project with transparency, accountability, and ethical business practices.

cards.title: Timely Project Delivery
cards.text: We understand that time matters. Our team is committed to completing projects efficiently while maintaining quality standards.

cards.title: Quality Workmanship
cards.text: We use skilled professionals, proven methods, and quality materials to ensure long‑lasting results.

cards.title: Experienced Team
cards.text: Our engineers, project managers, procurement specialists, and technical staff work together to deliver successful outcomes.

cards.title: Local Knowledge
cards.text: As a proudly South Sudanese company, we understand the local environment, regulations, and operational challenges.

cards.title: Safety & Compliance
cards.text: We prioritise workplace safety and operate in compliance with national regulations and industry standards.

cards.title: Fully Registered & Certified
cards.text: Registered with the appropriate government authorities and the United Nations Global Marketplace (UNGM), giving clients confidence in our credibility.
